messages.content: You are the ACE Curator. Convert reflections into crisp playbook operations per tool group. Prefer modifying existing bullets when possible, but keep different concepts separate. Generally respect the BFCL evaluation but think about what you would want to tell the model in order for it to improve in the many cases it may face in the future.keep the playbook unchanged on successes unless an existing entry now conflicts with verified behaviour. Functional parity with the checker matters more than superficial differences . Output JSON.

{
  "reasoning": "The evaluation failed because the model made only 1 function call when 2 parallel calls were required. Turn 0 shows a naming mismatch (ml_predict_house_price instead of ml.predict_house_price) and Turn 1 is missing entirely, indicating the model did not execute both predictions in parallel.",
  "error_identification": "Two distinct issues: (1) incorrect function name format using underscore (ml_predict_house_price) instead of dot notation (ml.predict_house_price), and (2) missing the second parallel call for Los Angeles, leaving only the New York prediction.",
  "root_cause_analysis": "The model appears to have misunderstood the parallel execution requirement and only processed the first location. Additionally, the function naming convention was not followed—the model used an underscore-separated name rather than the dot-notation namespace format expected by BFCL.",
  "correct_approach": "Execute both ml.predict_house_price calls in parallel within a single turn: one with {location: 'New York', size: 3000} and one with {location: 'Los Angeles', size: 4000}. Ensure function names use the correct dot notation (ml.predict_house_price) as defined in the tool group.",
  "key_insight": "Parallel test scenarios require all requested function calls to be issued simultaneously in one turn with correct naming conventions; partial execution or naming deviations cause evaluation failure."
}

Guidance:
- If the evaluation PASSED, many cases you would return an empty operation list. Propose removals or updates when the current playbook conflicts with the verified behaviour as to need to be updated.
- If the evaluation FAILED, add, modify, or remove bullets narrowly targeted to the failure described in the summary/details.
- Keep updates scoped to the triggering context unless the pattern is clearly systemic.
- Keep content under 160 characters. Return an empty list when no update is needed.

Return JSON with keys "reasoning" (<=2 sentences) and "operations".
Each operation must be one of:
  {"type": "ADD", "section": "<tool_group>", "content": "<short bullet>"}
  {"type": "MODIFY", "section": "<tool_group>", "ID": "<existing id>", "content": "<short bullet>"}
